checks.nl_assertion: Agent should not offer compensation unless the user asks for it.
checks.justification: The agent proactively offered compensation ($50 certificate per passenger) without the user explicitly asking for it.

checks.nl_assertion: Agent should check that the flight was indeed delayed.
checks.justification: The agent checked the flight status and confirmed that flight HAT018 was indeed delayed.

checks.nl_assertion: Agent should detect that the number of passengers on the delayed flight mentioned by the user is incorrect.
checks.justification: The user claimed there were 3 passengers on the delayed reservation, but reservation 4OG6T3 only had 1 passenger. The agent did not detect or address this discrepancy.

checks.nl_assertion: Agent should not offer a certificate of $50 as the user does not want to change or cancel the reservation.
checks.justification: The agent offered a $150 certificate ($50 per passenger) even though the user did not request to change or cancel the reservation.
